slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: source
slots.about: where it was published, a small line on top

slots.name: photo
slots.about: a wide picture; empty hides it

slots.name: headline
slots.about: the article's title, the largest text on the page

slots.name: summary
slots.about: a short summary under the title

slots.name: author
slots.about: who wrote it, beside a round initial

slots.name: published
slots.about: the date as words, put before the reading time

slots.name: paragraphs
slots.about: the body: id (1 up), text; an empty list shows no_body_text

slots.name: min_word
slots.about: after the minutes, e.g. ' min read'

slots.name: no_body_text
slots.about: shown in place of the body when there are no paragraphs

slots.name: likes
slots.about: how many liked it before this person

slots.name: like_label
slots.about: spoken label of the like button while not liked

slots.name: unlike_label
slots.about: spoken label of the like button once liked

slots.name: save_label
slots.about: spoken label of the save button while not saved

slots.name: unsave_label
